UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public profile for a MinePacks user without PII

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user

username.description: Public display username chosen by the user

isPublicProfile.description: Always true to allow public profile queries

packsCount.description: Cached count of packs published by the user

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

ResourcePack.title: ResourcePack
ResourcePack.description: Minecraft resource pack post in the MinePacks feed

description.description: Optional short description of the pack

imageUrl.description: Cover image URL, preset key, or compressed data URI

downloadUrl.description: External HTTPS/HTTP download link for the resource pack

authorAvatarUrl.description: Optional avatar URL of the publisher

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when pack was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when pack was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

PackLike.title: PackLike
PackLike.description: Per-user like record on a resource pack

userId.description: UID of the user who liked the pack

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when like was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

/users/{userId}.description: Public user profiles keyed by Firebase Auth UID

/packs/{packId}/likes/{likeUserId}.description: Likes subcollection keyed by liking user UID
